title: Information Theory from Spation States
description: Complete derivation of information, entropy, and channel capacity from SDT spation configurations.

overview.abstract: We derive information theory (information content, entropy, channel capacity, quantum information) from Spatial Displacement Theory using spation state configurations. Information is encoded in spation configurations. Entropy comes from geometric counting. Channel capacity arises from pressure propagation. Quantum information reflects spation state superpositions. All information theory emerges from pressure-mediated spation states, ultimately driven by CMB energy influx.
keyPoints: Information encoded in spation configuration states
Entropy arises from geometric counting of accessible states
Channel capacity determined by pressure propagation through spation
Quantum information reflects spation state superpositions
CMB provides continuous energy influx maintaining information encoding

keyConcepts.name: Information Content
keyConcepts.description: Information content is encoded in spation configuration states, measured as I = -log₂ P(state) where P is the probability of spation configuration.
keyConcepts.importance: Connects Shannon information theory directly to physical spation states rather than abstract mathematical constructs.

keyConcepts.name: Entropy from Geometry
keyConcepts.description: Entropy S = -k_B Σᵢ Pᵢ ln Pᵢ emerges from geometric counting of accessible spation configurations.
keyConcepts.importance: Thermodynamic entropy is shown to be fundamentally geometric, arising from counting possible spation arrangements.

keyConcepts.name: Channel Capacity
keyConcepts.description: Channel capacity C = max_{P(X)} I(X;Y) is determined by pressure propagation through the spation medium.
keyConcepts.importance: Information transmission limits are set by physical properties of pressure wave propagation in spation.

keyConcepts.name: Quantum Information
keyConcepts.description: Quantum information processing reflects spation state superpositions, where quantum bits correspond to spation configuration superpositions.
keyConcepts.importance: Quantum computing and information processing emerge naturally from spation superposition states.

keyConcepts.name: CMB-Driven Information
keyConcepts.description: The Cosmic Microwave Background provides continuous energy influx that maintains information encoding in spation states.
keyConcepts.importance: Information processing is ultimately powered by the same CMB energy source that drives all physical processes.

derivations.name: Information Content
derivations.description: Information content of a spation configuration state.
steps: Each spation can exist in different configuration states
Probability P(state) of each configuration determines its likelihood
Information content I measures how surprising/unlikely the state is
Logarithmic measure ensures additivity for independent configurations

derivations.name: Geometric Entropy
derivations.description: Entropy from geometric counting of spation configuration states.
steps: Count total number of accessible spation configurations Ω
Each configuration i has probability P_i = 1/Ω (for uniform distribution)
Boltzmann entropy S = k_B ln Ω
Shannon entropy generalizes to non-uniform distributions

derivations.name: Channel Capacity
derivations.description: Maximum information transmission rate through pressure-mediated spation channels.
steps: Information propagates through pressure waves in spation
Channel capacity limited by pressure wave propagation speed c
Mutual information I(X;Y) between input X and output Y configurations
Maximum over input distributions gives fundamental channel limit

variables.I(X;Y): Mutual information between input and output
variables.c: Speed of light (pressure wave propagation speed)
